name: kicktodo
description: KickTodo — the consumer guided-achievement distribution (PRD docs/kicktodo-prd.md §9.1–§9.3, ADR 0414). Include-mode: core substrate (goals/scheduler/kanban/chat/media/billing ride core) + the bundles the participant/creator/commerce loops compose (crm rides along: the commerce bundle hard-depends on it). The `kicktodo-core`/`kicktodo-creator` feature packages join `features[]` as they register (Workstream C/D); a dedicated `kicktodo` bundle grouping is added to bundles.json once those features exist with `category: kicktodo` (an empty grouping would violate the catalog invariants). Build identity only — runtime activation stays server-authoritative toggles.
